topic: Installation of components and assembling of circuits on a Bread board.
syllabus_extract: Installation of components and assembling of circuits on a Bread board.
specific_objectives: 24.11.1.1 Trainee will be able to mount and assemble circuits on a Bread board.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Mounting and assembling circuits on a Bread board; Safety precautions regarding short circuits and component polarity; Instructor supervision during insertion and verification.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a breadboard in circuit prototyping?
Identify three common electronic components used in basic circuits.
Explain why soldering is generally avoided during breadboard assembly.

topics: Introduction to Breadboard structure and internal connectivity
Identification and selection of passive components
Correct insertion techniques for resistors and capacitors
Polarity handling for diodes and integrated circuits
Verification of connections before power application
development.content:
Introduction to Breadboard structure and internal connectivity
Identification and selection of passive components
Correct insertion techniques for resistors and capacitors
Polarity handling for diodes and integrated circuits
Verification of connections before power application

topics: Step-by-step assembly of a simple series circuit
Troubleshooting open and short circuits on breadboard
Proper handling and storage of components
Documentation of circuit layout and component values
development.content:
Step-by-step assembly of a simple series circuit
Troubleshooting open and short circuits on breadboard
Testing circuit functionality with multimeter
Proper handling and storage of components
Documentation of circuit layout and component values

topics: Review of common assembly errors and prevention
Safety protocols for live circuit testing
Final inspection checklist for circuit integrity
development.content:
Review of common assembly errors and prevention
Safety protocols for live circuit testing
Final inspection checklist for circuit integrity
Transition to PCB layout concepts
Q&A session on practical challenges

summary_questions: Describe the correct method for inserting an integrated circuit into a breadboard.
How would you verify if a resistor is correctly oriented in a circuit?
What steps should be taken if a circuit fails to power on after assembly?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a preliminary sketch of a circuit layout for a given schematic, considering component placement and trace routing, to be used in the next lesson on PCB design.

pft_rows.syllabus: Design and preparation of PCB layout for a given circuit.
